changelog: Added Performance Mode settings to keep animations smooth on any device.
Introduced Time Management analytics to track your daily usage.
Added a new Media Gallery to view and download high-quality movie and show wallpapers.

features.title: What's New
items: Added Performance Mode with auto-detection to match your device's speed.
Added a Time Management dashboard with detailed charts to track your watch time.
Introduced a Media Gallery feature with instant image and poster downloading.
Added a new Discover header and interactive loading indicators.

features.title: Faster & Smoother
items: Added automatic performance tuning based on device capability.
Smoother page transitions and animations across movies, search, and profiles.
Reduced power consumption and lag when browsing large content collections.

features.title: Better Experience
items: Updated settings in the Profile section with new performance toggles.
Enhanced visual effects, glass styles, and mobile responsiveness.
Improved navigation speed when switching between app sections.
